title: Apartment Shrewsbury Park, Dublin 4, Dublin 4
description:
Stunning two bedroom/ two bathroom apartment on the first floor of a nine unit building in the heart of Ballsbridge.
1 Superking bed
1 king size bed in the second room

Located in a gated a secure complex, the apartment has been finished to the highest calibre with all Bosch appliances.

The main living area is open plan with an island for dining for three, the main dining area has a table for ten, along with the living area with custom made couches.

The apartment has a balcony area with dining for four as well as exterior lights, heating and outdoor sockets finished with a Portuguese granite.

The apartment benefits from ample off street parking.
